snippet.title: Set a Watch: Digital Edition - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
⚡ Add Set a Watch: Digital Edition to your Wishlist now! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493430/

Darkness is rising… Will you hold the line? 🛡️✨

We’re bringing Set a Watch: Digital Edition - a tactical, dice-based digital board game adaptation to Steam, Android, and iOS! 🔥 Assemble your party, roll your dice, and fight back the Unhallowed before darkness consumes everything. Every choice matters. Every battle is a test of skill. Can you survive the night? ⚔️
